name: pi-0.5
summary: pi-0.5 attacks open-world generalization by co-training on a deliberately heterogeneous mixture of multi-robot manipulation, high-level subtask annotations, web image-caption and VQA data, and verbal instructions from humans. At inference it first predicts a language subtask, then conditions the flow-matching action expert on it. The result cleans real, previously unseen homes for extended stretches.
innovation: Discrete-then-continuous inference: predict the next subtask in language, then generate actions conditioned on it.
Co-training across robot data, web data and human verbal coaching under one objective.
Evidence that generalization scales with the number of distinct training environments, not just hours of data.
matters: Reframed the bottleneck from motor skill to environmental diversity in the data.
limits: Still brittle on tasks needing precise force control; recovery from bad states remains weak.
lineage: pi-0's architecture plus Hi Robot's hierarchical language decomposition, trained on far broader data.
